purpose: Validate fresh-domain root support, helper preconditions, production/independent measurement agreement, and bounded resource readiness without generating scientific effect directions or formal generalization decisions.

seedAccessContract.policyAssignment: odd seed -> LGTTCI-P1-UNIFORM-LEGAL; even seed -> LGTTCI-P2-MIN-IMMEDIATE-CAPTURE

sfcdfCompatibility.eligiblePair: both frozen Namua/Mtaji roots exist, are nonterminal, retain required phases, and pass depth-5 bounded preflight
sfcdfCompatibility.measurement: run depth-5 RAW geometry production and independent implementations on both roots of every selected pair; require exact serialized agreement

silgmCompatibility.rootFamilyAssignment: first byte of SHA-256('LGTTCI-S1-SILGM-RF|' + seed) modulo 2; 0 -> RF1, 1 -> RF2
silgmCompatibility.phaseAssignment: first byte of SHA-256('LGTTCI-S1-SILGM-PHASE|' + seed) modulo 2; 0 -> namua, 1 -> mtaji
silgmCompatibility.selectedRoot: the frozen phase root from the deterministically assigned root family; unavailable roots are rejected without replacement

widthClasses.EQUAL: rootLegalWidth = frozen phase threshold; support diagnostic only

silgmCompatibility.cells: policy x rootFamily x phase x {LOW-RANKABLE,HIGH}
silgmCompatibility.measurement: for each selected rankable root run all frozen conditions through production and independent compatibility wrappers; require exact serialized agreement and no hard assertion

gcldCompatibility.checkpointEligibility: nonterminal checkpoint with depth-5 bounded preflight ELIGIBLE
gcldCompatibility.trajectoryEligibility: at least four eligible checkpoints and both namua and mtaji represented among eligible checkpoints
gcldCompatibility.measurement: run CRCLGR-R1-EXACT-SQUASHED-L1 production and independent measurement on all eligible frozen checkpoints of selected trajectories; require exact serialized agreement

noRescueAfterFirstFreshSeedRead: module dropping to improve study disposition
